I’m Md. Saiful Islam Ridoy — a growth-focused business development professional who likes understanding how things work, and how they could work better.

My background in Computer Science and Engineering gives me an analytical starting point. Working in marketing and business development has taught me to pair it with something equally important: understanding people.

I enjoy research, meaningful conversations, and turning what I learn into action. And outside the day-to-day, I make room for experiments like Hothat.
